senses.gloss: m. (corrupt. of אריסטיטא, ἀριστητής) break-fasting, in gen. invited guest. Pl. אֲרִיסְטִין, אֲרִיסְטַיָּיא.
units: Koh. R. to I, 3 שביק א׳ וכ׳ let the guests eat (some ed. אריסטון, our guests?).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:3">Lam. R. to IV, 2</cite> <he>ביני א׳</he> among the seated guests.
